body:
Minecraft Username: Out2Kill
Reason: Inappropriate behaviour
Why I should be unbanned?: Well I was really stupid and trying to piss of the staff, I took it too far. I don't want to waste half of my holidays being banned and I really enjoy the server ;). It's been 3 days since I've been banned, so I believe I've served my time. I hope you read my very short appeal as I have nothing else to say. And this is my first ban
